ruleCatalog.basis: Element 2D bounds must remain inside the source target envelope unless a tolerance records another origin/scale.
Level-resolved elements must be supported by the floor/slab footprint for that level.
Wall endpoints should connect to wall topology or be explicitly documented as free edges.
Door/window hosts must be real enclosing walls, not synthetic access-helper stubs.
Railings need an explicit host edge/stair or level relation.
Room separation lines are analysis/helper geometry and must not be confused with physical BIM.
Access-helper wall/door stubs are not target-house physical architecture.
Partial renderer support must produce structured diagnostics for target-house-critical evidence.
Machine-readable target-house scale, room, opening, and roof-court requirements must bind to the snapshot.
